ordering_note: Dependencies are a conservative sequential baseline. Independent work may proceed in parallel after technical prerequisites. Split or insert releases for unresolved gaps; 1.0 is acceptance-based.

phases.title: Foundation and useful vertical slice
phases.goal: Prove the same Rust transformation works in a real browser worker and a native host, then establish the contracts that prevent later rewrites.
phases.exit_gate: Do not expand into dozens of packages until the browser/native slice works and the difficult compatibility risks have explicit owners and evidence.

phases.title: Bytes, text and foundational encodings
phases.goal: Build common operations on the portable kernel while making text semantics and chunk boundaries explicit.
phases.exit_gate: Common recipes work correctly, but the overall product is not advertised as CyberChef-complete. Full regex dialect compatibility is a tracked later gate.

phases.title: Streaming, artifacts and execution foundations
phases.goal: Make large inputs, multi-input operations and resource limits real before adding heavyweight operation families.
phases.exit_gate: The engine can distinguish streaming from whole-input work, maintain bounded resources and publish only complete artifacts. This gate precedes broad archive and crypto expansion.

phases.title: Modern browser workbench
phases.goal: Build the daily-use experience without making a complex graph or GPU a prerequisite.
phases.exit_gate: The web application is useful as a self-contained tool. Native desktop/mobile packaging is still out of scope until after 1.0.0.

phases.title: Remote API, PostgreSQL and secure server execution
phases.goal: Add optional persistence and explicitly selected remote execution without changing local behavior.
phases.exit_gate: A server may be deployed safely with PostgreSQL, but local processing remains the default. Database replacement contracts exist before a second SQL backend is implemented.

phases.title: Structured formats, queries and utilities
phases.goal: Deliver data transformation breadth while preserving dialect and numeric semantics.
phases.exit_gate: Language interpreters and structured parsers are treated as high-risk providers with limits, not assumed interchangeable Rust crates.

phases.title: Compression and archives
phases.goal: Provide full compression/archive operation parity with explicit expansion, memory and file-system boundaries.
phases.exit_gate: All selected formats are available locally where the reference supports local execution. Native-only decompression is a parity gap, not a substitute.

phases.title: Modern hashing and cryptographic operations
phases.goal: Use reviewed providers and typed key material; do not confuse forensic capability with application security policy.
phases.exit_gate: Production cryptography is not written from scratch solely to reduce crate counts. Analysis operations and service TLS remain separate security domains.

phases.title: Legacy cryptography, hashes and classical ciphers
phases.goal: Close the long-tail compatibility scope without enabling obsolete security in the service.
phases.exit_gate: This phase may require substantial extra releases. A cipher name in a list is not evidence of compatible implementation or validated security.

phases.title: Public keys, certificates and tokens
phases.goal: Deliver parsing and cryptographic workflows without conflating parse, verify and trust decisions.
phases.exit_gate: No user analysis certificate or imported root is allowed to alter the application’s HTTPS/identity trust configuration.

phases.title: Network and forensic analysis
phases.goal: Cover network and forensic operations while separating passive parsing from controlled network effects.
phases.exit_gate: Native networking uses the central gateway and TLS seam. Passive protocol analysis uses independent parsers and cannot change application security settings.

phases.title: Images, media and document presentation
phases.goal: Deliver the complete relevant media catalogue without making GPU or cloud services mandatory.
phases.exit_gate: Media is a required parity workstream, not a reason to silently introduce cloud processing. Heavy packs may load on demand and must be available in offline bundles.

phases.title: Complete recipe semantics, Magic and compatibility
phases.goal: Finish behavioral compatibility at the workflow level, not just the operation list.
phases.exit_gate: This is the first feature-complete candidate, not general availability. Full functional parity cannot be established by counting operation names alone.

phases.title: Extensibility and replacement-adapter proof
phases.goal: Prove additions and infrastructure changes do not force edits throughout the engine or UI.
phases.exit_gate: Third-party plugins may be disabled by policy. First-party extensibility is mandatory. Future sibling readiness is not a blocker for 1.0 if the replacement boundaries are proven.

phases.title: Portability, collaboration and operations
phases.goal: Prove SQL portability and deployability while keeping optional server features separate from local processing.
phases.exit_gate: Supporting another database still requires its adapter, migrations and qualification. Independence means no core rewrite, not a promise that database switches are free.

phases.title: Qualification and general-availability readiness
phases.goal: Convert a feature-complete candidate into a defensible full release.
phases.exit_gate: After a passing 0.240.0-equivalent gate, publish 1.0.0-rc.1 and further candidates as required, then 1.0.0. The date and number of additional releases are intentionally not promised.

releases.title: Executable seed
releases.deliverable: Pin Rust 1.99.0; create kernel, engine, browser and native host packages; run one hex operation from a real browser worker.
releases.acceptance: Native and browser fixtures agree; the example needs neither PostgreSQL nor a sibling repository.

releases.title: Reference baseline
releases.deliverable: Resolve the reviewed tag and adopted current-source deltas to immutable commits; inventory operations, arguments, workflow features and licenses, including observed certificate-bundle parsing.
releases.acceptance: Every discovered operation has a stable tracking record; the reference commit and file hashes are recorded, not guessed.

releases.title: Application contracts
releases.deliverable: Define operation IDs, semantic revisions, structured errors, recipe envelopes, artifact references and local EngineClient commands.
releases.acceptance: Round-trip tests reject unknown required fields and preserve large offsets without JavaScript number truncation.

releases.title: Portable kernel
releases.deliverable: Separate no_std/no-alloc kernel, alloc-enabled compiler and std hosts; establish feature and target matrices.
releases.acceptance: Bare-metal-style compile checks catch std leakage; unsafe code is forbidden in first-party portable core by default.

releases.title: Bounded buffer contract
releases.deliverable: Add caller-provided input/output windows, consumed/produced counts, partial progress, cancellation checkpoints and finish states.
releases.acceptance: Zero-sized windows, short writes, empty inputs and repeated finish calls have defined results without panics.

releases.title: Operation descriptors
releases.deliverable: Define typed arguments, defaults, help, execution class, secret fields and capabilities; generate a minimal catalogue.
releases.acceptance: One new operation registers once and appears in catalogue, validation, documentation and generated argument controls.

releases.title: Linear execution
releases.deliverable: Compile and run a sequence of hex, text and XOR operations with explicit byte/text conversion.
releases.acceptance: Chunk partitions do not alter outputs; invalid intermediate types fail before execution where statically knowable.

releases.title: Worker protocol
releases.deliverable: Introduce versioned worker messages, input transfers, job generations, progress and error events.
releases.acceptance: Processing runs outside the UI thread; stale generations and malformed messages cannot update active results.

releases.title: Cancellation lifecycle
releases.deliverable: Implement cooperative cancellation and browser worker termination/recreation for non-cooperative work.
releases.acceptance: A cancelled job cannot publish a successful artifact; cancellation leaves the next job usable.

releases.title: First browser workbench
releases.deliverable: Build accessible input, recipe and output panes, operation search and a manual Run button.
releases.acceptance: Keyboard-only use completes a sample recipe; raw output is never interpreted as trusted HTML.

releases.title: Loopback API host
releases.deliverable: Expose capabilities, catalogue, validate, run, status and cancel through a replaceable HTTP adapter.
releases.acceptance: Local and HTTP clients pass the same contract suite; the development server binds loopback by default.

releases.title: Hard-feature feasibility
releases.deliverable: Exercise candidate regex, query-language, YARA, crypto, compression, disassembly and OCR strategies in browser and native spikes.
releases.acceptance: Record dialect, licensing, dependencies, limits and remaining gaps; unsupported candidates do not become assumed dependencies.

releases.title: Differential harness
releases.deliverable: Build a reference runner, fixture provenance rules and partitioned-input comparison harness.
releases.acceptance: Positive, negative, binary and Unicode cases run reproducibly; upstream bugs are recorded rather than blindly copied.

releases.title: First threat review
releases.deliverable: Review imported recipes, worker boundaries, preview escaping, logging and dependency graph.
releases.acceptance: No payload telemetry or automatic network side effects; hostile samples produce bounded failures.

releases.title: Usable vertical alpha
releases.deliverable: Package a small offline-capable workbench with recipe save/load, loopback API examples and developer operation guide.
releases.acceptance: A fresh clone builds and runs without sibling projects or a database; phase A contracts are demonstrated end to end.

releases.title: Byte inspection
releases.deliverable: Add hex dumps, binary, octal, decimal byte views and reversible dump parsing.
releases.acceptance: Offsets, delimiters, malformed rows and partial final lines match the selected compatibility profile.

releases.title: Integer and float formats
releases.deliverable: Add charcode, text-integer, arbitrary-width numeric conversion, BCD, float bit views and endianness controls.
releases.acceptance: Signedness, precision, overflow, NaN payloads and byte-order behavior have explicit tests.

releases.title: Base64 family
releases.deliverable: Add configured alphabets, padding policies, URL-safe forms and source/output offset mapping.
releases.acceptance: RFC vectors and reference arguments pass across every short-input chunk partition; padding is accepted only in valid positions.

releases.title: Base32 and Base45
releases.deliverable: Add available alphabet variants, whitespace policies and precise invalid-symbol diagnostics.
releases.acceptance: Case handling, trailing bits and incomplete blocks have separate strict and compatibility fixtures.

releases.title: Base58 and Bech32
releases.deliverable: Add leading-zero handling, checksummed forms and selected alphabet variants.
releases.acceptance: Checksums, mixed-case policy, network prefixes and maximum-length limits are enforced without ambiguous repair.

releases.title: Other base encodings
releases.deliverable: Add Base62, Base85, Base92 and generic-base operations from the inventory.
releases.acceptance: Exact alphabets, escaping and output lengths match fixtures; base conversion cannot request unbounded integer storage.

releases.title: URL and entities
releases.deliverable: Implement percent encoding/decoding, HTML entities and quoted-printable with explicit byte/text boundaries.
releases.acceptance: Reserved characters, malformed escapes and newline handling match documented profiles; results remain inert data.

releases.title: Unicode escapes and normalization
releases.deliverable: Add Unicode escapes, smart-character handling, normalization and versioned Unicode data.
releases.acceptance: Surrogate and invalid-sequence policy is explicit; normalization is tested at chunk boundaries and against table versions.

releases.title: Character encodings
releases.deliverable: Add an initial encoding-table pack, encode/decode operations and a complete remaining-encoding checklist.
releases.acceptance: Every enabled encoding has round-trip and lossy-mode tests; unimplemented table variants remain visible gaps.

releases.title: Text transformations
releases.deliverable: Add case transforms, trimming, diacritic removal, reverse, padding and character/word/line selection.
releases.acceptance: Byte, Unicode scalar, grapheme and legacy UTF-16 behaviors are not silently interchanged.

releases.title: Lines and collections
releases.deliverable: Add split/join, line filtering, numbering, deduplication and stable sorting.
releases.acceptance: Long lines and whole-input sorting obey budgets; ordering and empty-record semantics match fixtures.

releases.title: Search and replace core
releases.deliverable: Add literal search, bounded safe-regex mode, captures, replacement and highlighting as structured spans.
releases.acceptance: Safe-mode syntax is labelled distinctly from full compatibility regex; all highlighting is escaped by renderers.

releases.title: Bitwise and byte arithmetic
releases.deliverable: Add AND, OR, NOT, XOR, shifts, rotates, add/subtract and bounded brute-force primitives.
releases.acceptance: Key repetition, carry, signedness and integer overflow rules are deterministic across targets.

releases.title: Additional text encodings
releases.deliverable: Deliver Braille, Punycode, Modhex, COBS, caret/control encodings and MIME decoding from inventory.
releases.acceptance: Embedded zeroes, invalid framing, malformed labels and nested MIME limits have adversarial fixtures.

releases.title: Encoding completeness gate
releases.deliverable: Reconcile every basic encoding and text inventory row, including missing variants discovered during implementation.
releases.acceptance: A generated report separates complete operations, argument gaps and intentionally different safe defaults; no hidden omissions.

releases.title: Resource ledger
releases.deliverable: Account for input windows, queued bytes, operation state, output, cache, artifacts and provider allocations.
releases.acceptance: A deliberately expanding operation hits the declared budget; reported totals do not omit retained branch buffers.

releases.title: Backpressure scheduler
releases.deliverable: Add deterministic ready queues, bounded channels or equivalent credits and partial-output resumption.
releases.acceptance: Slow consumers cannot grow memory indefinitely; synchronous CPU work does not depend on an async task per node.

releases.title: Stream state machines
releases.deliverable: Standardize EOF, truncation, cancellation, errors, logical record boundaries and output completion.
releases.acceptance: Every state transition is tested; EOF is neither duplicated nor inferred from an arbitrary chunk boundary.

releases.title: Multi-input ports
releases.deliverable: Add constant parameters, immutable keys and synchronized data inputs with explicit joining policies.
releases.acceptance: Arrival order cannot change XOR/key semantics; unresolved inputs block safely and never grow unbounded buffers.

releases.title: Branches and joins
releases.deliverable: Implement graph regions, ordered fork/join, fan-out reference sharing and explicit merge policies.
releases.acceptance: Reconverging branches, slow consumers and early exits do not deadlock or lose output.

releases.title: Whole-input and seekable adapters
releases.deliverable: Support bounded accumulation, two-pass operations and seekable artifact readers.
releases.acceptance: Non-streaming operations declare their class and reject oversized jobs before uncontrolled allocation.

releases.title: Native artifact storage
releases.deliverable: Introduce staged artifacts, immutable manifests, range reads, leases and verified finalization on local disk.
releases.acceptance: Crash simulation cannot expose a partial artifact as complete; offsets and lengths are checked.

releases.title: Browser artifact storage
releases.deliverable: Implement IndexedDB metadata and optional OPFS chunk storage with memory/file fallbacks.
releases.acceptance: Firefox and other supported browsers work without optional APIs; quota failures never trigger silent upload.

releases.title: Storage transaction discipline
releases.deliverable: Add transaction-completion waits, chunk manifests, orphan cleanup and storage schema migrations.
releases.acceptance: Aborted transactions and interrupted writes are reported; no successful-write result precedes commit confirmation.

releases.title: Semantic content identities
releases.deliverable: Define canonical typed parameters, ordered ports, operation revision and chunk-independent input digests.
releases.acceptance: Repartitioning input leaves identity unchanged; different parameters or operation semantics never reuse an entry accidentally.

releases.title: Selective computation cache
releases.deliverable: Cache only deterministic, completed, permitted jobs using immutable input identities or completed spool hashes.
releases.acceptance: Unknown streams are not fully buffered merely to attempt an early hit; secrets and failed jobs are excluded by default.

releases.title: Cache lifecycle
releases.deliverable: Add per-workspace quotas, reference pinning, eviction, cancellation cleanup and encrypted-at-rest hooks where configured.
releases.acceptance: Eviction cannot delete a live artifact; cache misses and storage failures do not corrupt authoritative recipes.

releases.title: Bounded control-flow IR
releases.deliverable: Represent labels, conditional branches, bounded repeats, registers and subrecipes separately from DAG regions.
releases.acceptance: Graph-cycle rejection does not mistakenly eliminate required recipe loops; iteration/work budgets are enforced.

releases.title: Execution provenance
releases.deliverable: Record operation revisions, argument redactions, input references, diagnostics and exact reproducibility conditions.
releases.acceptance: Sensitive arguments stay out of logs; nondeterministic jobs cannot masquerade as reproducible cached results.

releases.title: Engine stress qualification
releases.deliverable: Exercise huge streams, joins, cancellation, expansion bombs, temporary storage exhaustion and corrupt artifacts.
releases.acceptance: Measured memory stays within each declared profile and errors remain recoverable; no universal constant-memory claim.

releases.title: Workspace shell
releases.deliverable: Add responsive resizable panes, themes, remembered non-sensitive preferences and command navigation.
releases.acceptance: Layout remains usable at narrow widths and high zoom; theme preference does not capture input content.

releases.title: Recipe editing
releases.deliverable: Add drag/drop with keyboard alternatives, undo/redo, duplicate, disable, reorder and parameter validation.
releases.acceptance: Editing preserves stable node identities and annotations; purely visual movement does not rerun processing.

releases.title: Generated operation inspector
releases.deliverable: Render argument forms, examples, defaults, capability warnings and semantic-version details from descriptors.
releases.acceptance: New descriptors require no handwritten duplicate API schema or form definition for supported field types.

releases.title: Safe automatic preview
releases.deliverable: Add debounced, bounded previews for permitted pure operations and an explicit full-run action.
releases.acceptance: Imported recipes and effectful/expensive operations never start merely because they were pasted or opened.

releases.title: Paged text viewer
releases.deliverable: Add incremental decoding, line indexing, search, selection and bounded text previews.
releases.acceptance: Large single lines and invalid UTF sequences do not force a full document string allocation.

releases.title: Virtual hex viewer
releases.deliverable: Add range-backed hex/ASCII viewing, exact offset navigation, selection and export.
releases.acceptance: Offsets above 32-bit ranges remain correct; UI memory is measured separately from underlying artifact storage.

releases.title: Structured and table viewers
releases.deliverable: Add lossless tree/table views, typed cell rendering, pagination and safe copy/export.
releases.acceptance: Large integers and binary values remain exact; untrusted strings cannot inject markup or spreadsheet formulas without warning.

releases.title: Graph editor
releases.deliverable: Add an optional visual graph for typed ports, branches, joins and structured control regions.
releases.acceptance: Invalid edges are rejected by the engine compiler, not only by visual UI rules; keyboard editing remains possible.

releases.title: Debugging controls
releases.deliverable: Add breakpoints, single-step, node diagnostics, intermediate inspection and cancellation status.
releases.acceptance: Viewing a preview does not prematurely terminate a full output stream or leak a secret artifact into history.

releases.title: Offset provenance UI
releases.deliverable: Show source/output correspondences where transformations provide them, including encoded-byte relationships.
releases.acceptance: Non-local or lossy transforms say unmappable/approximate explicitly rather than invent exact positions.

releases.title: Multiple inputs and batches
releases.deliverable: Add named inputs, file sets, deterministic batch ordering and per-item error policy.
releases.acceptance: A failed batch item cannot silently discard other results; files are not duplicated into UI state.

releases.title: Local recipe library
releases.deliverable: Add folders/tags, favourites, search, revision history and exportable local workspaces.
releases.acceptance: Persistence is opt-in for sensitive data; recipe export omits secrets and bulk inputs by default.

releases.title: Sharing and imports
releases.deliverable: Support recipe-only links/files, explicit input inclusion, compatibility links and import previews.
releases.acceptance: Users see capabilities and embedded data before running; history and URL exposure are clearly distinguished.

releases.title: Offline packaging
releases.deliverable: Cache versioned app assets and selected operation packs; provide a complete offline distribution option.
releases.acceptance: Offline operation availability is visible; service-worker upgrades cannot mix incompatible engine and pack revisions.

releases.title: Browser accessibility gate
releases.deliverable: Test keyboard, screen reader, focus, reduced motion, high contrast and touch-friendly responsive layouts.
releases.acceptance: Core tasks work without canvas-only controls, GPU acceleration, shared memory or a mouse.

releases.title: Public API specification
releases.deliverable: Stabilize pre-1.0 JSON envelopes, binary artifact routes, pagination, errors and capability negotiation.
releases.acceptance: Local and HTTP transports pass shared use-case tests; framework request types never enter the application layer.

releases.title: Job lifecycle API
releases.deliverable: Add queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired states, progress events and resumable observation.
releases.acceptance: Reconnection and duplicated requests cannot create ambiguous terminal states or leak another principal’s job.

releases.title: Artifact transfer API
releases.deliverable: Add bounded uploads, integrity checks, range downloads, retention and explicit remote-consent UX.
releases.acceptance: Incomplete uploads remain staged; large files do not travel as JSON Base64 payloads by default.

releases.title: Repository contracts
releases.deliverable: Define atomic recipe revision saves, job leases, permissions, metadata search and transaction boundaries.
releases.acceptance: Contracts describe domain semantics instead of generic execute-SQL methods; an in-memory adapter passes the suite.

releases.title: PostgreSQL adapter
releases.deliverable: Implement parameterized queries, pool configuration and migrations outside core domain packages.
releases.acceptance: Recipes and jobs pass repository tests on an actual PostgreSQL instance; driver row types stay in the adapter.

releases.title: Database TLS seam
releases.deliverable: Wire tokio-postgres through a replaceable TLS connector and explicit identity/trust configuration.
releases.acceptance: Certificate validation failures are fatal; a mock provider proves database TLS is not permanently tied to rustls.

releases.title: Identity and sessions
releases.deliverable: Add server authentication, bounded sessions, token expiry, CSRF defenses and optional identity-provider integration.
releases.acceptance: Authorization is enforced server-side for every object; browser-local use remains anonymous and database-free.

releases.title: Workspace authorization
releases.deliverable: Add owner/editor/viewer roles, tenant scoping and explicit service-account permissions.
releases.acceptance: Cross-workspace and confused-deputy tests fail closed even without database-specific row-security features.

releases.title: Isolated execution workers
releases.deliverable: Move remotely submitted CPU work into restricted processes with memory, CPU, disk and egress policies.
releases.acceptance: A parser crash or non-cooperative job can be killed without taking down API or other tenants.

releases.title: Admission and quotas
releases.deliverable: Add principal/workspace job quotas, maximum artifacts, rate limits and queue backpressure.
releases.acceptance: Repeated tiny requests and large expanding jobs cannot bypass aggregate resource accounting.

releases.title: Durable jobs and leases
releases.deliverable: Add job leases, fencing tokens, worker heartbeat, retry eligibility and idempotency records.
releases.acceptance: Expired workers cannot finalize duplicate results; retry is prohibited for unsafe external side effects.

releases.title: Server networking policy
releases.deliverable: Centralize outbound connections, redirects, destination restrictions, credentials and HTTP limits.
releases.acceptance: SSRF, rebinding, private/metadata destinations and mapped-address cases are covered before user HTTP operations are public.

releases.title: Metadata-only observability
releases.deliverable: Add health, readiness, redacted audit events, bounded metrics and structured operational errors.
releases.acceptance: Default logs contain no raw inputs, outputs, secrets or high-cardinality user payload labels.

releases.title: Server deployment profile
releases.deliverable: Ship a hardened single-node deployment with reverse-proxy and direct-TLS options, backups and cleanup jobs.
releases.acceptance: Restart and restore drills preserve metadata/artifact consistency; insecure development defaults cannot silently become public.

releases.title: Server security gate
releases.deliverable: Test authentication, object authorization, uploads, worker isolation, cancellation and resource abuse.
releases.acceptance: Public remote execution stays disabled until isolation and quota tests pass; local web mode remains independently releasable.

releases.title: JSON and CSV foundations
releases.deliverable: Add strict/lossless JSON, CSV conversion, configurable delimiters, quoting and invalid-input diagnostics.
releases.acceptance: Large integers, duplicate-key policy, multiline fields and final newline behavior are fixture-tested.

releases.title: XML and HTML data
releases.deliverable: Add XML/HTML extraction, formatting and escaping with external entity/network access disabled by default.
releases.acceptance: Entity expansion, excessive depth and malformed documents fail within budgets; renderers receive inert data.

releases.title: XPath and CSS selectors
releases.deliverable: Implement the selected reference dialects through isolated query providers and result adapters.
releases.acceptance: Namespaces, selector syntax and output formatting match compatibility fixtures; unsupported syntax is not silently simplified.

releases.title: JSON query dialects
releases.deliverable: Deliver the required JSONPath, JMESPath, jq/JSONata-style capabilities actually present in the pinned inventory.
releases.acceptance: Each discovered language has its own dialect/version tests; equivalent branding is not accepted as compatibility evidence.

releases.title: YAML and Rison
releases.deliverable: Add parse/emit and JSON conversions with explicit type inference and alias behavior.
releases.acceptance: Alias bombs, implicit scalar differences and non-string mapping keys are handled according to documented profiles.

releases.title: MessagePack and CBOR
releases.deliverable: Add lossless tagged/binary/numeric mappings and round-trip conversions.
releases.acceptance: Indefinite lengths, nesting, duplicate keys and extension types are bounded and represented without accidental loss.

releases.title: AMF and Avro
releases.deliverable: Add the pinned AMF variants and Avro-to-JSON requirements behind separate provider modules.
releases.acceptance: Unsupported schema features become tracked gaps; hostile references and lengths cannot escape limits.

releases.title: TLV and binary structures
releases.deliverable: Add configurable TLV parsing, field bounds and related binary-to-structured helpers from inventory.
releases.acceptance: Truncation, overlapping lengths, large tags and signed/unsigned decoding have negative tests.

releases.title: Code formatting and minification
releases.deliverable: Add the inventoried language beautifiers/minifiers using syntax-aware providers where semantics require them.
releases.acceptance: Strings, comments, regex literals and template syntax survive correctly; substitutions are not advertised as parsers.

releases.title: Mathematics and statistics
releases.deliverable: Add bounded integer arithmetic, modular functions, aggregates and statistical operations.
releases.acceptance: Precision, divide-by-zero, overflow and ordering are explicit and consistent across browser/native targets.

releases.title: Set and combinatorial operations
releases.deliverable: Add unions, intersections, differences, Cartesian products, power sets and permutation-style utilities.
releases.acceptance: Output cardinality is estimated and capped before exponential expansion; ordering matches fixtures.

releases.title: Time and identifiers
releases.deliverable: Add timestamp formats, duration helpers, UUID/object-ID interpretation and versioned time-zone data where required.
releases.acceptance: Invalid dates, offset transitions, precision and deterministic clock injection have tests.

releases.title: Distances and miscellaneous utilities
releases.deliverable: Add unit conversions, geographical calculations, formatting and remaining small utility operations.
releases.acceptance: Numeric units, coordinate ranges and rounding are explicit; map/network resources require declared capability or offline assets.

releases.title: Remaining text and encoding tables
releases.deliverable: Close missing code pages, language data, tokenization and utility variants discovered by the inventory.
releases.acceptance: Every claimed encoding/dialect identifies its data-table version and has native/browser fixtures.

releases.title: Structured-format gate
releases.deliverable: Run the full query/format corpus and publish per-argument, per-platform parity results.
releases.acceptance: Unsupported syntax remains a release blocker for 1.0; the plan extends rather than hiding difficult languages.

releases.title: Compression provider contract
releases.deliverable: Standardize streaming encoder/decoder state, trailing-data policy, dictionary limits and byte counters.
releases.acceptance: Truncated streams and short output buffers resume or fail deterministically without hiding retained state.

releases.title: Deflate
releases.deliverable: Add raw Deflate compression/decompression and reference parameter mapping.
releases.acceptance: Stored, fixed and dynamic blocks pass reference fixtures across all tested chunk boundaries.

releases.title: Zlib
releases.deliverable: Add wrappers, dictionary handling and checksums with strict and compatibility framing policies.
releases.acceptance: Header, dictionary-ID and checksum failures are distinguished; limits include dictionary memory.

releases.title: Gzip
releases.deliverable: Add gzip metadata, concatenated members, checksums and deterministic-output options.
releases.acceptance: Member boundaries and trailing garbage follow documented semantics; preview cannot skip final integrity validation.

releases.title: Bzip2
releases.deliverable: Deliver required compression/decompression variants through a reviewed provider.
releases.acceptance: Block limits, corrupt indexes and expansion attacks are tested in browser and native builds.

releases.title: LZMA and containers
releases.deliverable: Add the inventory’s LZMA/container variants with configurable but bounded dictionaries.
releases.acceptance: Dictionary size is validated before allocation; unsupported container variants remain named gaps.

releases.title: LZ4
releases.deliverable: Add required block/frame operations, checksums and content-size handling.
releases.acceptance: Frame flags, dictionaries, short blocks and independent/dependent block behavior match fixtures.

releases.title: LZ string encodings
releases.deliverable: Add LZ-based string and transport variants present in the reference.
releases.acceptance: UTF-16/code-unit behavior is reproduced explicitly rather than replaced with a superficially similar byte codec.

releases.title: Platform compression families
releases.deliverable: Add NT/XPRESS and other inventoried platform-specific formats without calling local shell utilities.
releases.acceptance: Published/reference samples and malformed streams work identically in the browser and native engine.

releases.title: ZIP listing and extraction
releases.deliverable: Add multi-entry archives, data descriptors, name encodings and password variants required by inventory.
releases.acceptance: Entry count, expansion, encryption errors and path normalization are bounded; extraction never writes arbitrary host paths.

releases.title: ZIP creation
releases.deliverable: Add selected compression methods, metadata mapping and deterministic archive options.
releases.acceptance: Round trips preserve required names and bytes; archives larger than basic format limits use supported extensions or fail clearly.

releases.title: TAR operations
releases.deliverable: Add listing, extraction and creation for required header variants and links.
releases.acceptance: Traversal, absolute paths, devices, symlinks and hardlinks cannot bypass the artifact namespace.

releases.title: Nested archive workflows
releases.deliverable: Connect archive outputs to file collections and bounded recursive processing.
releases.acceptance: Total nesting, members, bytes and work are capped across the whole job, not reset per nested archive.

releases.title: Archive UX and integrity
releases.deliverable: Add per-member inspection, safe selection, artifact exports and verification status.
releases.acceptance: Incomplete or checksum-failed outputs never appear as verified; selected member export preserves authorization.

releases.title: Compression qualification
releases.deliverable: Close all compression inventory gaps and run corpus-based fuzzing and expansion stress tests.
releases.acceptance: Every provider declares measured memory profiles; unsupported methods cannot be omitted from the parity denominator.

releases.title: Crypto provider boundary
releases.deliverable: Define key/nonce/tag types, randomness injection, algorithm identifiers and capability metadata.
releases.acceptance: Raw keys are redacted and excluded from default persistence/cache; no application transport depends on operation-pack crypto.

releases.title: SHA-2 and HMAC
releases.deliverable: Add required SHA-2 variants, HMAC parameters and streaming hash operations.
releases.acceptance: Known-answer vectors, long inputs and arbitrary partitions agree across targets.

releases.title: SHA-3 and Keccak
releases.deliverable: Add distinct SHA-3/Keccak variants and SHAKE-style extendable outputs where in scope.
releases.acceptance: Domain separation and output length are explicit; similar algorithm names cannot be substituted.

releases.title: BLAKE families
releases.deliverable: Add required BLAKE variants and optional BLAKE3 enhancement through narrow provider features.
releases.acceptance: Keyed/context modes and tree boundaries have vectors; provider upgrades cannot silently alter cache identities.

releases.title: Checksums and CRCs
releases.deliverable: Add inventory checksum families and parameterized CRC configurations.
releases.acceptance: Polynomial reflection, initial/final values and output byte order are independently tested.

releases.title: KDF primitives
releases.deliverable: Add PBKDF2, HKDF and related modern derivations with parameter ceilings.
releases.acceptance: Salt/info distinctions, output bounds and excessive iteration requests are tested; secrets remain tainted.

releases.title: Password derivation
releases.deliverable: Add bcrypt/scrypt and a separately labelled Argon2 enhancement when provider review permits.
releases.acceptance: CPU/memory costs are validated before scheduling; compatibility variants and truncation rules are explicit.

releases.title: AES block modes
releases.deliverable: Add inventoried AES modes, key lengths, padding and byte-format mappings.
releases.acceptance: Standard vectors and negative padding cases pass; insecure modes are analysis tools, never default application encryption.

releases.title: Authenticated encryption
releases.deliverable: Add required AEAD forms with staged decryption output and explicit tag verification.
releases.acceptance: A failed tag releases no plaintext artifact; all input/tag/nonce changes have negative vectors.

releases.title: AES key wrap
releases.deliverable: Add wrap/unwrap variants and integrity checks required by the reference.
releases.acceptance: Invalid key lengths, padding and integrity failures do not expose partially unwrapped material.

releases.title: ChaCha and Poly1305
releases.deliverable: Add exact ChaCha variants, counters and authenticated combinations when in scope.
releases.acceptance: Counter overflow and nonce construction are checked; variant differences remain visible in descriptors.

releases.title: Salsa family
releases.deliverable: Add Salsa20/XSalsa20 operations with exact key, nonce and counter semantics.
releases.acceptance: Known vectors and boundary conditions work in streaming and one-shot paths.

releases.title: Fernet and authenticated wrappers
releases.deliverable: Add Fernet and related required wrappers with timestamp and token-format handling.
releases.acceptance: Authentication precedes plaintext publication; injected clock and expiry policy are testable.

releases.title: Random and prime generation
releases.deliverable: Add explicit deterministic PRNG operations and secure random/prime generation through distinct providers.
releases.acceptance: Seeded analysis tools are not mistaken for CSPRNG; entropy failure is fatal where secure randomness is required.

releases.title: Modern crypto qualification
releases.deliverable: Run independent vectors, malformed inputs, cross-provider comparisons and secret-lifecycle checks.
releases.acceptance: No known high-severity provider issue remains; side-channel claims are limited to evidence and platform capabilities.

releases.title: Legacy safety separation
releases.deliverable: Package historical algorithms with explicit analysis labels and separate features from application security.
releases.acceptance: Enabling every operation cannot weaken HTTPS, sessions, storage encryption or identity verification.

releases.title: DES and Triple DES
releases.deliverable: Add modes, padding and historical key conventions required by reference fixtures.
releases.acceptance: Weak-key and parity-bit handling is documented; outputs match independent known-answer tests.

releases.title: Blowfish and RC2
releases.deliverable: Deliver required modes and parameter variants through reviewed implementations.
releases.acceptance: Key expansion limits, effective key bits and legacy padding have positive and negative fixtures.

releases.title: RC4 and Rabbit
releases.deliverable: Add stream variants, RC4-drop controls and exact byte semantics.
releases.acceptance: State persists across chunks; skip/drop parameters cannot cause uncontrolled work.

releases.title: TEA family
releases.deliverable: Add TEA, XTEA and XXTEA with explicit word order and length conventions.
releases.acceptance: Short messages, padding and unusual variants have independently sourced compatibility cases.

releases.title: Additional block ciphers
releases.deliverable: Add required RC6, Twofish, PRESENT and other inventoried block families.
releases.acceptance: Each algorithm/variant is separately tracked; an unavailable provider causes more 0.x work, not an unlabelled replacement.

releases.title: SM4 and GOST encryption
releases.deliverable: Add required modes and parameter sets with explicit identifiers.
releases.acceptance: Parameter-set selection is reproducible; names alone cannot choose an incompatible implementation.

releases.title: Ascon variants
releases.deliverable: Add the exact Ascon versions exposed by the pinned reference and separately identify newer variants.
releases.acceptance: Algorithm revision, nonce/tag lengths and byte-order differences are verified rather than conflated.

releases.title: Historical hashes
releases.deliverable: Add required MD/SHA-0/RIPEMD and other legacy digest families.
releases.acceptance: Every inventoried variant has test vectors; obsolete digests remain labelled unsuitable for modern integrity security.

releases.title: Specialist hashes
releases.deliverable: Add inventoried GOST/SM3/Whirlpool/Snefru/HAS-160 and other uncommon digests as applicable.
releases.acceptance: Provider absence, missing variants and licensing restrictions stay visible until resolved.

releases.title: Fuzzy and similarity hashes
releases.deliverable: Add the reference’s fuzzy/context-triggered hashes and comparison utilities.
releases.acceptance: Similarity scores, block sizes and edge cases match reference behavior; results are not represented as cryptographic proofs.

releases.title: Classical substitution
releases.deliverable: Add ROT families, Vigenere, Morse, Bacon, Affine, Atbash, A1Z26, substitution and related inventory entries.
releases.acceptance: Alphabet, case, punctuation and non-ASCII policies are explicit and fixture-tested.

releases.title: Classical transposition
releases.deliverable: Add Bifid, Rail Fence, Caesar Box and other inventoried transposition/novel encodings.
releases.acceptance: Incomplete grids, key validation and reverse transforms preserve the required conventions.

releases.title: Historical machines
releases.deliverable: Add Enigma/Typex/Lorenz/SIGABA and associated analysis tools such as Bombe/Colossus when inventoried.
releases.acceptance: Machine settings and known historical/reference fixtures agree; expensive searches have strict work budgets.

releases.title: Legacy completeness gate
releases.deliverable: Deliver remaining EVP/CipherSaber/Citrix/LS47 and other residual legacy entries, splitting releases as necessary.
releases.acceptance: Generated coverage shows no unowned long-tail algorithm or argument gap; all required browser paths are tested.

releases.title: ASN.1 and OIDs
releases.deliverable: Add bounded BER/DER parsing, ASN.1 display and OID conversions required by inventory.
releases.acceptance: Excessive lengths, recursion, non-canonical encodings and truncated objects have precise failures.

releases.title: PEM and key representations
releases.deliverable: Add PEM/hex/JWK conversions and typed private/public key containers.
releases.acceptance: Key types, curves, leading zeros and private-field redaction survive round trips.

releases.title: X.509 parsing
releases.deliverable: Add certificate fields, extensions, public-key extraction, certificate-bundle parsing and required display forms; pin the adopted current-source delta.
releases.acceptance: Parsing success is never labelled certificate trust; unknown extensions remain available as data.

releases.title: CRLs and CSRs
releases.deliverable: Add revocation-list and signing-request parsing with explicit signature-verification actions.
releases.acceptance: Invalid signatures and malformed fields are distinguished from mere parsing errors.

releases.title: RSA operations
releases.deliverable: Add key generation, encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify with exact padding/hash options.
releases.acceptance: Entropy, key-size budgets, padding failures and reference compatibility are tested; no raw-secret logging.

releases.title: ECDSA operations
releases.deliverable: Add selected curves, key generation, signing/verification and signature-format conversion.
releases.acceptance: DER versus fixed-width forms, low-S policy and invalid curve points are handled explicitly.

releases.title: SM2 and GOST signatures
releases.deliverable: Add inventoried public-key operations, identity parameters and GOST wrap/sign variants.
releases.acceptance: Parameter sets and user-identity fields have vectors; missing provider variants remain blocking gaps.

releases.title: OpenPGP parsing and keys
releases.deliverable: Add packet/key inspection and generation with the pinned reference’s capability matrix.
releases.acceptance: Unsupported packets or algorithms are reported precisely; packet lengths and recursion are bounded.

releases.title: OpenPGP encryption
releases.deliverable: Add encrypt/decrypt and key-selection behavior for required OpenPGP formats.
releases.acceptance: Integrity-protected output stays staged until verified; legacy insecure forms are clearly identified.

releases.title: OpenPGP signatures
releases.deliverable: Add sign/verify and combined encrypt/sign workflows with separate validity and trust reports.
releases.acceptance: Detached/embedded signatures, canonical text and multi-signature cases match fixtures.

releases.title: SSH key analysis
releases.deliverable: Add host-key parsing, fingerprints and inventoried conversions.
releases.acceptance: Algorithm distinctions and malformed length fields are bounded; no SSH connection is implied by parsing a key.

releases.title: JWT and token inspection
releases.deliverable: Add decode/sign/verify with explicit permitted algorithms and key types.
releases.acceptance: Decode never implies validation; algorithm confusion, missing signatures and key-type mismatch tests fail closed.

releases.title: Signed session formats
releases.deliverable: Add Flask-session and other inventoried signed-container workflows.
releases.acceptance: Timestamp, compression, secret encoding and serializer variants are fixture-tested without persisting signing secrets.

releases.title: Key and secret UX
releases.deliverable: Add ephemeral secret slots, import warnings, copy/export confirmation and reproducibility redaction.
releases.acceptance: Recipe sharing cannot accidentally include private keys; browser/OS memory erasure limitations are documented honestly.

releases.title: Public-key qualification
releases.deliverable: Run independent vectors, malformed corpora, interoperability and browser/native conformance.
releases.acceptance: Every advertised algorithm/format is tested; a successful parse, a valid signature and a trusted identity remain distinct states.

releases.title: IP and network primitives
releases.deliverable: Add IP-format conversion, subnets, CIDR calculations and related byte/address operations.
releases.acceptance: IPv4/IPv6, mapped addresses and boundary masks have fixtures without accidental outbound traffic.

releases.title: URL and domain analysis
releases.deliverable: Add URL parsing, extraction, defang/refang and domain helpers from inventory.
releases.acceptance: Decoding order and Unicode display cannot silently change a network destination.

releases.title: HTTP data parsing
releases.deliverable: Add request/response, headers, cookies, content metadata and related format operations.
releases.acceptance: Ambiguous framing is reported; parsing hostile HTTP never routes it through the live service parser as a trusted request.

releases.title: User HTTP request operation
releases.deliverable: Expose explicit browser-fetch and controlled native-gateway modes with credential/redirection policy.
releases.acceptance: Browser CORS limitations are visible; remote mode passes SSRF and egress tests and never runs automatically on import.

releases.title: DNS data and queries
releases.deliverable: Add required DNS parsing/lookup capabilities with separate local-data and network modes.
releases.acceptance: Network use requires consent/capability; responses, name compression and timeout/work limits are bounded.

releases.title: TLS and SSH fingerprints
releases.deliverable: Add inventoried JA3/JA4/HASSH and related passive fingerprint operations.
releases.acceptance: Fingerprint versions and normalization rules are explicit; analysis of legacy handshakes does not enable legacy TLS transport.

releases.title: Packet and protocol extraction
releases.deliverable: Add required packet/protocol field parsers, protobuf/varint helpers and payload extraction.
releases.acceptance: Truncation, nested lengths and reassembly limits are tested; unsupported protocol revisions are reported.

releases.title: File identification
releases.deliverable: Add versioned signatures, confidence explanations, strings and binary structure probes.
releases.acceptance: Detection is labelled heuristic where appropriate; input-controlled paths or extensions do not override byte evidence.

releases.title: Executable analysis
releases.deliverable: Add the inventoried executable formats and section/header extraction with bounded reads.
releases.acceptance: Corrupt offsets and huge section counts fail safely; extracted code is never executed.

releases.title: Disassembly
releases.deliverable: Integrate the required architectures/modes through isolated providers and structured instruction results.
releases.acceptance: Native/browser outputs and syntax options match the selected reference; architecture support is enumerated, not implied.

releases.title: YARA language support
releases.deliverable: Deliver the exact required YARA syntax/module behavior and compiler diagnostics.
releases.acceptance: Rule corpus covers modules, strings, conditions and language variants; a subset implementation cannot claim full parity.

releases.title: YARA execution controls
releases.deliverable: Add match offsets, metadata, warnings, cost limits and killable worker execution.
releases.acceptance: Hostile rules and many matches respect budgets; scanning requires no filesystem/network privileges.

releases.title: Carving and extraction
releases.deliverable: Add byte signatures, embedded artifact carving and bounded output collections.
releases.acceptance: Overlapping candidates, nested files and excessive matches cannot exceed job-wide quotas.

releases.title: Forensic analysis views
releases.deliverable: Add entropy maps, byte frequency, comparisons and inventoried statistical/search helpers.
releases.acceptance: Sampling versus full analysis is labelled; results are deterministic for a fixed input and algorithm revision.

releases.title: Forensic completeness gate
releases.deliverable: Reconcile network/forensic inventory, capabilities, passive/active distinctions and offline availability.
releases.acceptance: No browser-local reference capability is silently replaced by a server-only implementation.

releases.title: Media provider boundary
releases.deliverable: Define bounded image/frame/audio artifacts, metadata, dimensions and deterministic decode policy.
releases.acceptance: Pixel/frame/duration limits are checked before allocation; corrupted metadata cannot request unbounded buffers.

releases.title: Image decoding
releases.deliverable: Add every required input image format and animated variant via reviewed feature-selected providers.
releases.acceptance: Browser/native decode fixtures record color, alpha and frame semantics; unavailable codecs remain explicit gaps.

releases.title: Image encoding
releases.deliverable: Add reference output formats, metadata policy and deterministic options where possible.
releases.acceptance: Quality settings and byte-level nondeterminism are documented; exact output comparisons use the right compatibility criteria.

releases.title: Geometry transforms
releases.deliverable: Add resize, crop, rotate, flip and related inventoried image operations.
releases.acceptance: Coordinate bounds, interpolation options, orientation and very large dimensions are fixture-tested.

releases.title: Color transforms
releases.deliverable: Add channels, grayscale, inversion, brightness/contrast and required color operations.
releases.acceptance: Color space, alpha premultiplication and clamping rules are explicit and reproducible.

releases.title: Filters and effects
releases.deliverable: Add required blur/sharpen/convolution and other image effects from inventory.
releases.acceptance: Kernel costs and edge behavior are bounded; arbitrary filter input cannot cause uncontrolled GPU/CPU allocation.

releases.title: Image composition
releases.deliverable: Add layering, text/annotation and inventoried composition helpers.
releases.acceptance: Fonts/assets are local and versioned; untrusted text remains inert and export respects declared dimensions.

releases.title: Steganography and bit planes
releases.deliverable: Add required image byte/bit extraction and embedding operations.
releases.acceptance: Capacity limits, channel order and malformed payloads have round-trip and negative tests.

releases.title: QR and barcode generation
releases.deliverable: Add required symbologies and rendering options.
releases.acceptance: Payload capacity, error correction and invalid character sets are checked against reference fixtures.

releases.title: QR and barcode recognition
releases.deliverable: Add local recognition for inventoried formats with deterministic input preprocessing.
releases.acceptance: Recognition failure is explicit; no image is uploaded to a third-party recognition service.

releases.title: OCR
releases.deliverable: Add a local OCR provider and required language/model pack handling with bounded worker execution.
releases.acceptance: Model availability, accuracy corpus, memory costs and browser support are measured; absent languages are tracked gaps.

releases.title: Image and audio metadata
releases.deliverable: Add EXIF/ID3 and required metadata extraction/editing or display operations.
releases.acceptance: Nested metadata, thumbnails and encoding variants are bounded; metadata is not interpreted as trusted markup.

releases.title: Audio and other media operations
releases.deliverable: Deliver inventoried playback/visualization/transforms using provider or browser presentation adapters.
releases.acceptance: User activation requirements and codec support are visible; playback is never automatic for imported recipes.

releases.title: PDF/HTML/media preview
releases.deliverable: Add the presentation behaviors actually required by the reference, with isolated preview surfaces and download fallback.
releases.acceptance: Active content cannot access app origin, secrets or APIs; no unsupported claim of a full Rust PDF renderer.

releases.title: Media qualification
releases.deliverable: Close format/argument gaps, compare outputs using declared tolerances and test malicious media corpora.
releases.acceptance: Baseline use works without WebGPU; optional acceleration produces equivalent results within documented tolerances.

releases.title: Compatibility interpreter
releases.deliverable: Complete execution of imported reference recipe sequences using the bounded control-flow IR.
releases.acceptance: Recipes with disabled operations, defaults and mixed data types preserve documented semantics.

releases.title: Fork and Merge compatibility
releases.deliverable: Map reference branch/delimiter behavior to typed graph regions and ordered joins.
releases.acceptance: Empty branches, delimiters and nested forks match fixtures independently of runtime chunking.

releases.title: Subsection processing
releases.deliverable: Add bounded subsequence selection and reinsertion with exact offset/text semantics.
releases.acceptance: Boundary, Unicode and changing-output-length cases preserve the required surrounding data.

releases.title: Registers and variables
releases.deliverable: Implement reference register capture/substitution plus typed native variables and secret references.
releases.acceptance: Scope, escaping, missing registers and lifetime rules are deterministic; secrets do not leak into recipe serialization.

releases.title: Labels and jumps
releases.deliverable: Deliver forward/backward and conditional jumps with explicit iteration and total-work limits.
releases.acceptance: Looping reference fixtures pass; exhausted limits return a precise diagnostic rather than hang.

releases.title: Return and nested recipes
releases.deliverable: Add early return, comments, subrecipe calls and reusable parameterized recipe blocks.
releases.acceptance: Return scopes and nested budget inheritance are tested; recursion is bounded or rejected by the declared profile.

releases.title: Compatibility recipe importer
releases.deliverable: Import supported JSON and URL recipe encodings into the canonical model with a diagnostic report.
releases.acceptance: Unknown operations/arguments are preserved for review or rejected, never silently dropped.

releases.title: Compatibility exporter
releases.deliverable: Export representable recipes to the reference format and native full-fidelity format.
releases.acceptance: Unrepresentable graph features produce an explicit report; no misleading successful export loses behavior.

releases.title: Detection primitives
releases.deliverable: Add versioned signature, alphabet, entropy and structure detectors with bounded sampling.
releases.acceptance: Detectors explain evidence and uncertainty; a score is not advertised as a calibrated probability without validation.

releases.title: Magic one-step suggestions
releases.deliverable: Suggest candidate reversible transforms and display previews without changing the active recipe.
releases.acceptance: Suggestions require user acceptance; network, secret-revealing or expensive actions are excluded by default.

releases.title: Magic bounded search
releases.deliverable: Add multi-layer transform search with deduplication, depth/work budgets and reproducible ranking.
releases.acceptance: Adversarial recursive inputs terminate; repeated runs on the same data/revision produce stable candidate ordering.

releases.title: Brute-force analysis
releases.deliverable: Complete required XOR/rotation/encoding/language-scoring searches and ranked result presentation.
releases.acceptance: Work estimates, candidate limits and cancellation are effective; heavy searches are never automatic by default.

releases.title: Full regex compatibility
releases.deliverable: Close remaining XRegExp/JavaScript syntax, Unicode, capture, replacement and formatting gaps through the approved strategy.
releases.acceptance: Reference dialect corpus passes locally and natively; safe-regex mode remains separately identified.

releases.title: End-to-end reference recipes
releases.deliverable: Run a broad versioned corpus combining formats, crypto, loops, archives, media and forensic operations.
releases.acceptance: Equality criteria cover bytes, structure, diagnostics and allowed nondeterminism; every mismatch has a tracked disposition.

releases.title: Feature-complete parity candidate
releases.deliverable: Reconcile operation, argument, recipe, UI and browser/native matrices against the frozen reference.
releases.acceptance: No required capability is missing; any open gap creates additional 0.x releases before qualification.

releases.title: Operation SDK
releases.deliverable: Publish first-party operation scaffolding, descriptor validators, fixture templates and threat-review guidance.
releases.acceptance: A sample operation is added without modifying scheduler, HTTP routes, database schema or handwritten UI forms.

releases.title: Operation pack manifests
releases.deliverable: Group operation implementations by capability, version, dependency footprint and platform support.
releases.acceptance: Required dependencies are explicit; removing a pack cannot produce silently incomplete loaded recipes.

releases.title: Lazy browser packs
releases.deliverable: Add on-demand loading and an explicit complete offline-pack catalogue.
releases.acceptance: App, engine and pack versions are verified before activation; failed downloads leave a usable previous state.

releases.title: Provider replacement tests
releases.deliverable: Run selected operations against alternate providers behind stable semantic descriptors.
releases.acceptance: Replacement requires byte/behavior conformance and security review; provider identity participates where it affects reproducibility.

releases.title: Core-Wasm plugin ABI
releases.deliverable: Specify a narrow versioned ABI for memory, metadata, bounded I/O, errors and capability requests.
releases.acceptance: The ABI contains no host pointers, unrestricted syscalls or implicit network/file access.

releases.title: Browser plugin sandbox
releases.deliverable: Load plugins in a separate worker/instance with allowlisted imports, resource limits and explicit grants.
releases.acceptance: An infinite loop, memory growth or hostile output can be terminated without accessing app state or persistent secrets.

releases.title: Native plugin sandbox
releases.deliverable: Add a reviewed Wasm runtime adapter with fuel/epoch or equivalent limits and constrained host calls.
releases.acceptance: Resource and capability tests cover malicious modules; signatures are not treated as proof of safety.

releases.title: Plugin package integrity
releases.deliverable: Add manifests, hashes, optional signatures, provenance, revocation and administrator policy.
releases.acceptance: Unknown publishers are not automatically trusted; rollback protection and offline integrity checks have tests.

releases.title: Plugin conformance kit
releases.deliverable: Publish ABI vectors, boundary fuzzing, malformed-module tests and example portable operations.
releases.acceptance: Plugin authors can validate behavior without depending on the web framework or database.

releases.title: Component-model evaluation
releases.deliverable: Evaluate a WIT/component adapter using the required JavaScript shims/transpilation where needed.
releases.acceptance: Keep it optional unless browser/native portability and resource enforcement match the established plugin contract.

releases.title: HTTP server replacement seam
releases.deliverable: Implement a second minimal/mock HTTP adapter and route conformance suite for a future Vef provider.
releases.acceptance: All application endpoints run without importing the original framework outside its adapter package.

releases.title: Outbound HTTP replacement seam
releases.deliverable: Centralize identity, user HTTP, object-storage and other outbound clients behind application-owned gateway policy.
releases.acceptance: No native subsystem opens an unreviewed HTTP/TLS path; destination and trust policies survive provider substitution.

releases.title: TLS replacement seam
releases.deliverable: Test inbound/outbound TLS and database TLS connectors with alternate/mock providers for future Brynja integration.
releases.acceptance: Trust, hostname verification, ALPN, timeouts and errors remain explicit; browser-owned TLS is documented as outside this seam.

releases.title: Conditional sibling integrations
releases.deliverable: Add real Vef/Brynja adapter packages only when their APIs and security properties are usable; otherwise ship contract harnesses.
releases.acceptance: The default build works without sibling paths; integration is not claimed complete when only a placeholder exists.

releases.title: Extensibility qualification
releases.deliverable: Demonstrate a new operation, new pack, provider swap and transport replacement through the public contracts.
releases.acceptance: No domain/database/UI rewrite is needed; every accepted extra dependency has a documented purpose and feature budget.

releases.title: Shared recipe collections
releases.deliverable: Add server-backed folders/tags and permission-aware recipe sharing without default input sharing.
releases.acceptance: Revoking access prevents future reads; links and searches cannot enumerate another workspace.

releases.title: Recipe revisions and conflicts
releases.deliverable: Add optimistic revision checks, compare/restore and explicit multi-client conflict handling.
releases.acceptance: Two clients cannot silently overwrite each other; no real-time collaboration framework is required.

releases.title: Administrative policy
releases.deliverable: Add operation/pack allowlists, egress policy, resource profiles and retention settings.
releases.acceptance: Policy is enforced server-side and reported through capabilities; clients cannot self-authorize forbidden operations.

releases.title: Audit and retention lifecycle
releases.deliverable: Add bounded audit export, retention jobs, object deletion and backup-retention documentation.
releases.acceptance: Payloads are absent by default; deleted live records and retained backups are not misleadingly described as immediate erasure everywhere.

releases.title: Logical storage export
releases.deliverable: Export portable recipe, identity-reference, job and artifact manifests using versioned logical records.
releases.acceptance: Export is independent of PostgreSQL SQL syntax and contains explicit integrity/referential checks.

releases.title: MySQL portability prototype
releases.deliverable: Implement actual MySQL repository methods and backend-specific migrations in a separate adapter.
releases.acceptance: Shared contracts run against a real MySQL instance; merely compiling a generic driver is insufficient.

releases.title: SQL semantic parity
releases.deliverable: Exercise collation, uniqueness, JSON values, booleans, timestamps, pagination and transaction behavior on both databases.
releases.acceptance: Results and conflict semantics agree despite different SQL dialects; deviations stay inside adapters.

releases.title: PostgreSQL-to-MySQL migration drill
releases.deliverable: Import a logical export into MySQL, verify hashes/counts/references, rehearse cutover and rollback.
releases.acceptance: Application use cases work without domain or API changes; failures leave the original deployment recoverable.

releases.title: MySQL-to-PostgreSQL reverse drill
releases.deliverable: Reimport the same logical model and repeat repository and authorization tests.
releases.acceptance: Round trips retain identifiers/revisions; the project makes no unsupported zero-downtime migration guarantee.

releases.title: Artifact backend portability
releases.deliverable: Exercise local-disk and an optional object-storage adapter against the same artifact contracts.
releases.acceptance: Range reads, integrity, leases and orphan cleanup work without tying metadata schema to one cloud provider.

releases.title: Backup and disaster recovery
releases.deliverable: Document and test coordinated metadata/artifact backups, schema recovery and corruption detection.
releases.acceptance: Restore drills actually read and execute restored recipes/artifacts instead of only checking backup file existence.

releases.title: Release packaging
releases.deliverable: Produce versioned static offline bundles, native API binaries and container images with manifests and notices.
releases.acceptance: Builds identify exact dependency and operation-pack revisions; no desktop/mobile application is shipped yet.

releases.title: Upgrade and rollback
releases.deliverable: Add compatible server/browser/pack upgrade rules, migration prechecks and rollback guidance.
releases.acceptance: An interrupted upgrade cannot mix incompatible schema/engine assets or corrupt saved recipes.

releases.title: Operational load qualification
releases.deliverable: Exercise realistic multi-user mixes, expensive-job fairness, disk pressure and process failure.
releases.acceptance: Published limits come from measurements; API responsiveness survives isolated worker exhaustion.

releases.title: Portability and operations gate
releases.deliverable: Close deployment docs, actual second-database contract tests and Vef/Brynja replacement rehearsals.
releases.acceptance: PostgreSQL is the initial production-supported backend; MySQL support level is stated separately from the proven portability contract.

releases.title: Scope freeze
releases.deliverable: Freeze the 1.0 reference commit, operation revisions, recipe schema, API and required browser profiles.
releases.acceptance: Later upstream additions enter a separate backlog; security fixes remain eligible for inclusion.

releases.title: Catalogue audit
releases.deliverable: Independently reconcile every operation and argument against the pinned baseline and category/source inventories.
releases.acceptance: No unexplained omissions, duplicate counting or native-only substitutions inflate the compatibility claim.

releases.title: Workflow and UI audit
releases.deliverable: Verify save/load, links, multiple inputs, breakpoints, offsets, Magic and complete control flow.
releases.acceptance: Workbench parity is demonstrated beyond unit tests; safety differences are documented prominently.

releases.title: Cross-target conformance
releases.deliverable: Run native and actual Chromium, Firefox and WebKit suites with and without optional browser features.
releases.acceptance: Required capabilities work on the published baseline; simulated wasm compilation alone is not sufficient.

releases.title: Resource and denial-of-service audit
releases.deliverable: Fuzz parsers, recipe compilation, regex, queries, archives, images and plugin host interfaces.
releases.acceptance: Memory/work/depth/output limits hold; discovered crashes and hangs are triaged and fixed before release.

releases.title: Unsafe and dependency audit
releases.deliverable: Review unsafe islands, crypto providers, build scripts, generated tables and transitive dependency changes.
releases.acceptance: No unreviewed dependency exception or known unmitigated high-severity issue remains in the release profile.

releases.title: API and authorization assessment
releases.deliverable: Exercise adversarial authentication, sessions, object permissions, uploads, egress and worker isolation.
releases.acceptance: Confirmed critical/high findings are fixed and regression-tested; accepted lower risks have owners and rationale.

releases.title: Data and cache assessment
releases.deliverable: Verify secret handling, cache isolation, completed-artifact publication, deletion and backup behavior.
releases.acceptance: Cross-tenant cache probing and partial-result disclosure tests fail closed; documentation matches actual retention.

releases.title: Accessibility and usability assessment
releases.deliverable: Test realistic tasks with keyboard, screen readers, high zoom, narrow layouts and error recovery.
releases.acceptance: Essential tasks have non-canvas alternatives; accessibility failures are fixed rather than deferred to native apps.

releases.title: Performance characterization
releases.deliverable: Publish reference hardware/browser measurements for startup, interaction, throughput, memory and cancellation.
releases.acceptance: Claims distinguish streaming from whole-input operations and cold from warm caches; no invented speedup multipliers.

releases.title: Supply-chain release proof
releases.deliverable: Produce dependency/asset manifests, license notices, signed checksums and reproducibility evidence for distributed artifacts.
releases.acceptance: Independent clean builds can verify the release process; supplied models/fonts/data are licensed for redistribution.

releases.title: Migration and disaster drill
releases.deliverable: Re-run PostgreSQL/MySQL portability, schema upgrade/rollback and metadata/artifact restore on release candidates.
releases.acceptance: Recovery preserves recipe revision and authorization invariants; operational instructions are executable.

releases.title: Documentation and SDK freeze
releases.deliverable: Finalize API reference, operation docs, extension guide, offline setup, threat model and migration contracts.
releases.acceptance: Examples are exercised in CI; docs disclose compatibility limits and browser-owned TLS boundaries.

releases.title: Release-candidate rehearsal
releases.deliverable: Produce a feature-frozen candidate build and run the full acceptance checklist with representative users.
releases.acceptance: Blocking issues produce further 0.x releases; the version number cannot waive missing functionality or security gates.

releases.title: GA acceptance decision
releases.deliverable: Assemble evidence for all mandatory capabilities, parity matrices, security, accessibility, recovery and provider boundaries.
releases.acceptance: Advance to 1.0.0-rc only when every mandatory gate passes; otherwise continue 0.241.0 and beyond with concrete gap releases.

ga_gate: Full baseline operation/argument/workflow/UI and required browser/native parity; API v1; PostgreSQL production; actual second-database portability proof; proven HTTP/TLS replacement boundaries; security/accessibility/recovery qualification.
future_apps: Desktop and mobile application delivery occurs only after 1.0.0.

release_candidates.gate: All pre-1.0 mandatory capabilities and qualification gates pass; exact artifacts enter candidate verification.
